sources.quote: Chi Ursae Majoris or χ Ursae Majoris, formally named Taiyangshou, is a single star in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Major.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 137 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,482 K, so 19.432 solar radii.

sources.quote: The star has an orange hue and is visible to the naked eye at night with an apparent visual magnitude of 3.72.
